rubric.role_summary: Senior motor fleet insurance underwriting role managing a business portfolio, assessing risk, working with brokers, supporting portfolio analysis, and mentoring underwriting colleagues.
rubric.search_query:
Find candidates for this role:
Senior motor fleet insurance underwriting role managing a business portfolio, assessing risk, working with brokers, supporting portfolio analysis, and mentoring underwriting colleagues.
Mandatory professional qualifications:
- Extensive experience underwriting motor fleet insurance.
Preferred, not mandatory:
- Experience dealing with large corporate customers.
- ACII qualified or working towards it.
- Experience working closely with product teams on product, process and customer-journey enhancements for a product roadmap.
- Track record of building strong and supportive relationships with insurance brokers.
- Ability to collate data to support monitoring and analysis of an underwriting portfolio.
- Comfort using AI in underwriting work while retaining personal judgment on decisions.
Work location and geographic eligibility:
Location: Greater London, UK area. Hybrid work is based in this area, and candidates must currently be located in it. Specific cities and metropolitan areas also include any location within about 100 miles (160 km) of them; states, countries, and regions require a location inside them.
